test_title: PYST 5: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the daughter of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B' and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the father of B'.

If 'P + Q ÷ R × S - T', then based on the above, how is P related to T?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68649cacfa98245f0ceb36f716a73c5c632a9f59d024076540dec2107071feb2.png] 

Given expression: P + Q ÷ R × S - T

P + Q: P is the daughter of Q.

Q ÷ R: Q is the father of R.

R × S: R is the wife of S. 

S - T: S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52e241efc6fb6b5186c4dc68d0a78c49fd53f72f11d838dcc69d46e3a3f5af3e.png] 

Thus, P is brother's wife's sister of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
